# ECN-2026-012 - Change notice - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01

Reason for change
-----------------
Background: Production and quality reviews identified drift in billet surface condition and inconsistent ring geometry downstream of the ring rolling cell fed by EQ-P2-L2-IH01. Investigation traced the primary causal vector to uncontrolled variation in billet core temperature at transfer into the ring rolling mandrel zone. Measured variability correlated with process nonconformances recorded against QS-PROC-07 and with operator entries in SOP-P2-L2-04. The engineering change narrows acceptable billet thermal condition to reduce metallurgical variability and improve first-pass yield.

Change summary: The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C. This ECN formalizes heater operating setpoint verification, introduces procedural updates to SOP-P2-L2-04 for transfer gating, and mandates maintenance actions referenced in MM-P2-L2-IH01 to support stable control of the heater process.

Rationale: Holding the billet at the specified target reduces the frequency of corrective heat work at the mandrel and limits microstructural heterogeneity in wrought sections. The change aligns heater control expectations with metallurgical acceptance criteria captured in QS-PROC-07 and provides a traceable means to demonstrate compliance for customer audits.

Affected items
--------------
- Equipment: All operating procedures and operator training linked to EQ-P2-L2-IH01.  
- Procedures: SOP-P2-L2-04 will be revised to include explicit verification steps for the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C and to document the acceptance criteria at transfer.  
- Maintenance records: MM-P2-L2-IH01 preventative and corrective work orders will be updated to include heater element and sensor validation tasks that support maintaining the specified target.  
- Quality documentation: QS-PROC-07 will reference this ECN as the source controlling allowable billet thermal input for ring rolling feedstock.

Implementation
--------------
Scope: Apply to EQ-P2-L2-IH01 on line P2-L2 and to all associated written work instructions, calibration records, operator checklists, and maintenance task lists. Implementation will follow the steps below.

Steps:
- Update SOP-P2-L2-04 to include a clear verification routine that confirms the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C prior to transfer from the heater to the ring rolling cell. The revision will replace any ambiguous language with a firm acceptance statement and required entries in the operator log.
- Modify MM-P2-L2-IH01 maintenance workflows to incorporate heater control sensor checks and validation steps that ensure the heater can reliably achieve and maintain the specified target. Maintenance closures must include the updated sign-off template.
- Revise QS-PROC-07 cross-references to point to this ECN and to require quality hold and verification steps whenever operator records show deviation from the specified target. Nonconforming product flows shall follow the disposition routes described in QS-PROC-07.
- Train all affected personnel on revised SOP-P2-L2-04 and the implications for feedstock staging and ring rolling acceptance. Training records will be maintained in the document control system and referenced to this ECN.

Examples of application:
- Example entry in the operator log (as required by the revised SOP-P2-L2-04): Record the confirmation that the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C and note any hold actions taken.  
- Example maintenance closure in MM-P2-L2-IH01: Record the sensor verification outcome and reference the heater element service performed to support consistent attainment of the specified target.

Records to keep
---------------
- Operator logs and checklists updated under SOP-P2-L2-04 showing verification that the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C at transfer.  
- Maintenance task completion records and validation checklists under MM-P2-L2-IH01 demonstrating sensor and heater element condition supporting the specified target.  
- Quality control verification records and any disposition documentation created under QS-PROC-07 when billets are found outside the acceptance criteria.  
- Training attendance and competency sign-offs for personnel who operate or maintain EQ-P2-L2-IH01.

Approvals
---------
This change requires concurrence from the following functions before release into controlled documents:
- Plant operations management for line P2-L2 to confirm operational readiness and staffing for the revised verification steps.  
- Maintenance supervision responsible for MM-P2-L2-IH01 to confirm updates to maintenance workflows and tooling.  
- Quality assurance to update QS-PROC-07 references and disposition criteria.  
- Document control to issue the revised SOP-P2-L2-04 and to archive prior revisions.

Post-implementation review
--------------------------
Post-implementation, a targeted review will be conducted to assess the effectiveness of the change. The review will use records listed above to verify adherence and to evaluate any reduction in downstream nonconformances referenced in QS-PROC-07. Findings will be used to refine SOP-P2-L2-04 and maintenance activities in MM-P2-L2-IH01 as needed.

Related documents
-----------------
See: MM-P2-L2-IH01, QS-PROC-07, SOP-P2-L2-04

Distribution
------------
Electronic distribution to plant P2 operations, maintenance, quality, and document control libraries. Hard copy available upon request to the plant document owner.
